fish.title: Ancient Fish
fish.description:
The Ancient Fish can only be caught after completing all Vault of the Waves bundles, and simultaneously completing the Something's in the Water accomplishment.

Note: there have been reports from players that the Ancient Fish has been caught before completing these bundles, but after speaking to Einar about lifting the lockdown.
